_note: Pre-registered experiments. Thresholds are fixed here BEFORE running, and every experiment is reported, including failures. Edit only with a dated note explaining why; changing a rule after seeing results invalidates it.

feature_group.text: PASS if the group lowers out-of-sample log-loss vs the base model on the same days (Diebold-Mariano one-sided p < 0.10, at least 250 days).

short_history_group.text: Groups with < 3 years of history: stacked on top of the base model's probability, walk-forward; PASS if p < 0.10 on at least 120 out-of-sample days.

strategy.text: PASS if net P&L per trade > 0 with t >= 2, deflated Sharpe >= 0.95 across all strategy trials, and at least half the trades priced on real option data. PROMISING if net > 0 and t >= 1. FAIL otherwise.

meta.text: PASS if net per trade on kept trades beats all trades while keeping >= 70% of them.

forward.text: Forward-only data (live recordings, LLM briefs): INSUFFICIENT_DATA until 60 sessions exist.
